title: Head of Business Development
description:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.


In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 
 

Where You'll Create Impact

  • Build!

  • Recruit, onboard, coach and develop a high-performing UK BDR team

  • Own the day-to-day performance of the BDR function, setting clear expectations around activity, qualified meetings, pipeline generation and conversion

  • Build a strong outbound culture centered around quality, accountability, consistency and continuous improvement

  • Run regular 1:1s, call coaching, team meetings, performance reviews and development conversations

  • Use activity, conversion and pipeline data to identify performance gaps and improve results across the funnel

  • Work closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, coordinate outbound activity and maintain high-quality opportunity handovers

 

What Sets You Up for Success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • Proven experience managing BDRs or SDRs within a B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Strong understanding of modern outbound prospecting, particularly cold calling, email, LinkedIn and account-based approaches

  • Previous success in an individual pipeline-generation or closing sales role, giving you first-hand understanding of what strong prospecting looks like

  • Strong coaching skills with the ability to identify why someone is underperforming and turn that diagnosis into practical improvement

  • Experience building or improving sales processes, messaging, sequences, qualification frameworks or outbound playbooks

  • High expectations of yourself and your team, combined with the ability to coach people constructively and help them improve

 

Why You’ll Thrive Here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

title: Growth Lead (Lifecycle & CRM)
description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.


About the Role

We match over 90% of our candidates to relevant roles. Getting people through the door isn't the hard part anymore. What happens after is.

By year end we'll 5x our candidate pool. Every one of those people generates behavioural signal almost no one else in recruitment holds. Right now, our opportunity lies in how we use that signal to engage and re-engage candidates with the right message at the right moment.

This isn't traditional CRM. It's a growth role that lives in the inbox and the product.

You'll lead lifecycle inside the growth team: activation, onboarding, education, re-engagement, across email, notifications and in-product. Nobody owns this today. You'll build it from nothing..

In this role you will:

  • Own the lifecycle stack end to end. Choose and implement the right tooling, then build the segmentation, triggers, and cadences that make it an activation engine, not a newsletter.

  • Sequence candidate onboarding sensibly. Design the journeys that take someone from signup to their first valuable actions, faster — the early steps we know predict a candidate sticking around and converting.

  • Turn behavioural signal into personalised journeys. We know things about our users that almost no one else in recruitment does. Make every message feel like it came from someone paying attention.

  • Educate users on the product. Build the communications that help candidates understand and get value from Dex, and partner with marketing to keep the voice consistent across every channel.

  • Own reactivation as a core metric. A lot of value sits in re-engaging users at the right moment in their journey. You’ll build the sequences that do it, and you’ll be measured on it.

  • Build the reporting layer from the ground up. Define what good looks like, instrument it properly, and make lifecycle performance legible to the rest of the company.

  • Keep tests in flight constantly. Kill what doesn’t work quickly, double down on what does, and keep a clear record of what we’ve learned.

  • Report to the Head of Growth and build with product and engineering. The best lifecycle work at Dex lives inside the product, not just the inbox. You’ll shape both.

About you

  • You’ve stood up lifecycle or CRM from scratch. Built the engine, not inherited and tended one someone else designed.

  • You come from a consumer tech or software business, where your work centred on the consumer experience and the workflows people actually move through.

  • You think in growth metrics, not marketing metrics. CAC to LTV, unit economics, conversion rate, revenue growth - that’s how you frame your work, not opens and sends.

  • You’re highly technical, analytical, and commercial. You pull your own numbers, spot what matters, and build the case for what to do next without waiting on anyone.

  • You’ve worked hand in hand with growth teams, and you’ve done it at early-stage companies. You’re at home in a small, fast-moving business and you’d take that over big tech.

  • AI fluent. Everyone on this team uses agents to be more effective and execute faster, and you will too.

  • Strong product instincts. You understand that the best message is sometimes a product change, and you can argue for both.

  • You care about craft - how every message reads, not just when it sends.

  • Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who’s fun to work with.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

 

Practical details

  • Right to work in the UK is required

  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship

 

If the above sounds like you and you want to work at the centre of a fast-moving startup, we’d love to hear from you! Applying will take you to our careers page, where you can apply directly.


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

title: Strategic Partnerships Lead, Technology Partnerships
description:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s, with no new entrants in 30 years. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers. We're looking for people with a track record of accomplishing difficult things, whether through their careers or achievements outside of work. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community - because that's what it takes to reinvent a $220B industry.

Where you'll create impact

You'll be responsible for driving the Technology channel end-to-end. The core skill is convincing tech partners that building an integration into DualEntry is worth their engineering time. That's a different motion than co-marketing; it's product-influencing.

Your role includes:

  • Managing a book of ~20 relationships at steady state; 10 mature partnerships under active management, 10 net-new relationships being opened

  • Driving inbound traffic to attract the next wave of integration partners

  • Owning monthly (and sometimes weekly) partner standups. We already work with exciting partners like Ramp and Deel on a monthly and sometimes weekly cadence. You'll own those relationships and make sure our product and integration story is best-in-class

  • Partnering deeply with our Head of Product and Product Managers to coordinate internal and external engineering teams as integrations expand

  • Representing DualEntry at industry events and running our own tech partner events

  • Using account mapping and ecosystem intelligence tools (e.g., Crossbeam) to identify overlap and activate co-sell opportunities

  • Managing partner agreements from strawman to signature, balancing structural fairness with commercial outcomes

Why tech partners actually choose to build with us. Our product team ships with velocity and iterates on API access faster than anyone in this space. It's one of the top reasons tech partners choose to build with DualEntry over the legacy incumbents.

What sets you up for success

  • 3 to 6 years in technology / ISV partnerships, business development, or ecosystem roles at a B2B SaaS company

  • Track record of taking integration partnerships from first conversation to launched, revenue-generating motion, and of managing a portfolio of relationships at scale (a mix of mature, actively-managed partners and net-new ones being opened)

  • Ability to influence external product roadmaps; comfort operating alongside Product and Engineering counterparts on both sides to coordinate integration work

  • Comfort negotiating partner agreements and referral terms directly, from strawman to signature

  • Familiarity with account mapping / ecosystem intelligence tools (e.g., Crossbeam) to identify overlap and activate co-sell opportunities

  • Strong internal collaboration instincts across product, marketing, and sales

  • Comfortable representing the company at industry events, including running your own partner events

  • Data-driven and experimental mindset

  • Comfortable operating in high-speed, high-ownership startup environments

Nice to have:

  • Fintech, ERP, or office-of-the-CFO ecosystem experience

  • Familiarity with account mapping tools (Crossbeam, Reveal) and partner ops tooling

  • Existing network among B2B SaaS integration partners (spend management, billing, payroll, treasury, banking data, CRM, RevOps)

  • Experience at an early-stage (Seed to Series B) company

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Meet the Partnerships Team

  • Caelahn joined DualEntry to build the partnerships function from zero; inherited 323 partner conversations, defined our 4-channel taxonomy, and stood up the attribution and program infrastructure to activate and scale across all four channels in his first 8 weeks. He's now launching Technology, Advisory, Resellers, and Private Equity in parallel.

Partnerships is how AI-native ERP wins. The legacy players took 30 years to build their networks. We're doing it at Series A, and we're going to make DualEntry the default across every finance ecosystem.

Caelahn Bullen, Strategic Partnerships Lead

title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

  • You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness"

 

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs.

  • Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines.

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team

  3. Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team

  4. Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Highlight the most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

title: Senior Performance Lead - Trade Acquisition
description:
As our next Senior Performance Marketing Lead, Trade Acquisition, you'll take single-point accountability for how we grow trade supply through paid channels. This isn't about hitting numbers someone else set. It's about setting the goals, building the roadmap and owning the strategy that the whole trade acquisition function is measured against. You'll shape how we invest, what we prioritise, and how the acquisition engine evolves over the next 12 to 24 months, working alongside senior stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product and Finance.

Forget long lists, here’s what you’ll actually spend your time on:

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Raft is building the enterprise AI platform for supply chain - the industry that literally keeps the world moving.

We’ve built deep credibility in the supply chain sector, partnering with more than 60 global leaders to eliminate manual processes, unify fragmented systems, and unlock intelligence at scale. Along the way, we’ve raised $45M from Bessemer Venture Partners and Eight Roads to accelerate this mission.

With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • The problem is real, and the scale is global. The supply chain industry moves $19 trillion of goods a year. We're building the AI workforce that makes it run smarter. Your work will matter.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

Hanham Woods Academy is a secondary school located within the outskirts of Bristol and South Gloucestershire, delivering education to more than 800 pupils aged 11-16. It is one of the most improved academies in the South West, and has a growing reputation both locally and regionally.

While we appreciate the unique setting in which the academy is placed, we work hard to challenge students from a variety of backgrounds to be the best they can be in all areas of life. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share and flexible working opportunities will be considered.

title: Associate, Legal Operations
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a skilled, tech-savvy Legal Operations Specialist to join our fast-paced legal team. As a core member of the department within a leading payment processing company, you will help drive operational excellence, scale our legal tech stack, and streamline workflows.

The ideal candidate helps bridge the gap between legal expertise, technology, and data-driven efficiency. You will be responsible for managing our complex contract ecosystems, optimising team collaboration tools, and leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) to design modern, automated legal processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Legal Tech Stack & Automation Strategy: Support the administration, integration, and continuous improvement of our legal technology tools, with a heavy emphasis on Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems.

  • Atlassian Ecosystem: Support the legal department's Jira infrastructure. This includes assisting with the design, maintenance, and optimisation of workflows in Jira Service Management (JSM) for legal intake, helping manage Jira Spaces, and building out a comprehensive, user-friendly knowledge base in Confluence.

  • AI & Process Engineering: Proactively identify opportunities to embed AI and machine learning tools into everyday legal operations, supporting the development and implementation of AI-driven efficiencies (e.g., automated contract review, AI search optimisation, legal operations chatbots, and automated triaging) to help reduce cycle times.

  • Workflow Optimisation: Evaluate existing legal processes, identify bottlenecks in the payment processing legal pipeline (e.g., merchant agreements, vendor contracts, regulatory tracking), and engineer streamlined, scalable workflows.

Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.

We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.

OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team 

We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model. 

Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions. 

By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization.

About the role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer who can own the journey of data from source systems to decision-ready outputs. You’ll build and maintain pipelines, model data, stand up dashboards, and integrate systems via APIs. In a team this size, you’ll also get involved in application development - building internal tools with Streamlit, FastAPI, or HTMX that put data directly in the hands of our investment and asset management teams. 

In your first 3 months you’ll have taken ownership of at least one critical pipeline from an external system into Databricks, and built or materially improved a reporting layer used by Fund Management or Asset Management.

  • Integrate internal and third-party systems via REST APIs, improving data accessibility across the business.
  • Champion data quality - implement validation, monitoring, and governance practices that give stakeholders confidence in the numbers.
  • Collaborate directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into data solutions.

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE OF THE ART TECHNOLOGY

We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior Software Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. 

Based in London, you will be a key player in designing, building, and evolving our web-based football analytics platform. Working across backend services and frontend UX/UI, you will contribute to a broad range of product capabilities that help professional football teams analyse and work with complex performance data in an intuitive and effective way.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will take ownership of features from design through implementation and deployment, contribute to technical decisions, and continuously improve the quality of our code, architecture, and development practices. You will work closely with Product and other engineering teams to turn product requirements into reliable, high-quality software that delivers real value to our customers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Contribute substantially to the design, implementation and maintenance of efficient, reusable and reliable code to solve a variety of customers' needs while considering existing technology, architecture and processes
  • Help drive code quality, organisation and best practices throughout the entire development process and in coordination with team objectives
  • Actively participate in team engineering processes, design meetings and code reviews with the view of continuously lifting quality and improving
  • Contribute to our test strategy by helping define test cases, authoring unit tests and driving automation wherever appropriate
  • Bring a growth mindset to every task -- sharing ideas and opinions with an attitude and appetite for improvement; the ability to challenge, pursue outcomes and take ownership of tasks in a collaborative environment 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, designing, building, and operating production grade applications and services
  • Strong experience with Java / Spring Boot and a modern JavaScript / TypeScript framework such as Angular or React
  • Experience with Kotlin is a plus, but not required
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including data modelling, query design, and performance optimization
  • Strong understanding of API design, distributed systems, and client server architectures
  • Experience with automated testing, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and release automation
  • Ability to take ownership of features and technical solutions from architecture and implementation through to production and ongoing operation

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

title: Growth PM
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Growth PM to own data and growth experimentation across the full funnel, from landing page through to in-app and pricing. ElevenLabs drives significant paid and organic traffic across self-serve, developer, and enterprise funnels; your job is to turn more of it into subscriptions, pipeline, and revenue.

You'll own the experimentation engine end to end: uncovering opportunities through funnel and product data, building and prioritizing the testing backlog, designing and evaluating experiments, and owning the tracking and reporting that turns results into decisions. Your scope runs deeper than conversion optimization: you'll drive experiments across onboarding, activation, and pricing, and align paid media, design, engineering, and product teams around one optimization roadmap.

The ideal candidate is equal parts analyst, strategist, and operator: someone who finds revenue hiding in funnel and product data, ships a high-velocity testing program, and communicates results in terms of subscriptions and pipeline, not just conversion rates.

Requirements

  • A track record of running high-velocity experimentation programs end to end - hypothesis, prioritization, test design, and analysis - with measurable revenue impact

  • Experience running experiments beyond the marketing site: in-product (onboarding, activation) and pricing or monetization

  • Deep analytics fluency: comfortable living in product analytics tools (e.g., PostHog, Amplitude, GA4) to diagnose funnel drop-off, segment traffic, and attribute outcomes across multi-domain journeys

  • Strong statistical literacy: you know how to size tests, avoid false winners, and choose the right success metric (revenue and subscriptions over clicks)

  • A cross-functional operator who can align paid media, design, engineering, and product teams around a shared optimization roadmap

Bonus

  • Working front-end web development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React) to build test variants without waiting on engineering

  • Experience optimizing PLG/self-serve funnels alongside sales-assisted (demo/contact-sales) funnels

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

The Exchange team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, margin systems and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in C++, Go, Rust, and Python, depending on the product they are contributing to within Kraken and work agile around the globe. Recently, the Trading Technologies team played a critical role in scaling Kraken's trading infrastructure.

The opportunity

  • Lead and grow a team of 8-10 engineers owning core trading backend services, including the matching engine, market data gateways, and order entry systems

  • Guide the team through the ongoing evolution of our trading stack, from legacy systems to their modern replacements

  • Stay technically close enough to the stack to unblock, review, and contribute to architecture discussions across matching engine, market data, and order entry work with ability to jump in and assist with coding

  • Champion performance and market data work as top priorities, while also supporting the team's broader technical scope

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering practices into the team's workflow and help engineers adopt them

  • Partner cross-functionally with product and other engineering pods to drive roadmap execution

  • Represent the team technically with peer teams and stakeholders, communicating tradeoffs and progress clearly

 

What you bring

  • Experience managing engineering teams, with a preference for managers who stay technically engaged rather than purely administrative

  • Prior hands-on experience in at least one of the following using Linux: distributed and/or highly-concurrent systems; low-latency and/or high-volume transaction environments

  • Proficiency in Rust and/or C++; comfort operating in a team split across C++, Rust, Go, and Python

  • Demonstrated knowledge of order types, trading systems, and financial products

  • Experience with Aeron or similar messaging/transport systems a strong plus

title: Capture and Proposals Associate
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Global Deal Desk sits between the sales team and closed revenue on every deal that runs through a formal procurement, security review, or RFP, which describes most of what TRM sells to governments, law enforcement, and financial institutions. Capture is the front half: engaging before an RFP exists, helping a customer define what they need, and positioning TRM as the answer rather than one of several responses to a fixed question list.

We are building this function now, so you will help build the machine: the playbook, the answer library, and the AI tooling that lets the desk answer more without lowering the standard.

The impact you will have:

  • Own proposal execution end to end on standard-tier pursuits: responses, compliance matrices, portal Q&A, and submission, turning technically correct answers into genuinely compelling ones.

  • Build the response engine: own the agentic tooling that drafts and manages responses from approved source material, so the desk scales on leverage rather than headcount.

  • Build the answer library and the playbook so a question answered once is never researched twice, and a new pursuit starts from something rather than nothing.

  • Orchestrate the cross-functional work: sequence Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, and Customer Success so a complex pursuit converges on a date instead of arriving at one.

  • Keep the function learning: run the gate reviews, the after-action reviews, and the AI-supported knowledge base that make the next bid cheaper than the last.

  • Sharpen win strategy: research the customer, competitors, and requirement, and over time help shape the pursuit itself.

What we're looking for:

  • An exceptional writer who makes complex material clear and answers a requirement as written rather than around it.

  • Genuinely AI-fluent: you already build with these tools, you know which parts a model should never own, and you can tell a right answer from one that only reads well.

  • Sharp, curious, and fast on ambiguous problems; you can take a 700-question workbook nobody has read and turn it into a plan.

  • Highly organized under real deadlines, able to run several high-stakes workstreams at once without dropping threads.

  • Strong with people: you can coordinate senior stakeholders who do not report to you and get what you need.

  • Genuinely excited to build something new and to own it as it grows.

  • Nice to have: exposure to capture, proposals, bids, or RFP responses in commercial or public-sector and government contracting; familiarity with blockchain, crypto, fintech, compliance, or the national security and law enforcement space; APMP membership or equivalent; additional languages.

About the Team:

  • Small, high-standard team building the capture function now; this seat works directly with the Capture Director, Head of Global Deal Desk, regional VPs, and account directors, plus Product, Legal, Security, and Finance.

  • The work is intellectually demanding: shaping a pursuit before an RFP exists, and turning correct answers into compelling ones under a scored process.

  • You own it as it grows, with a clear path to shaping and running larger pursuits.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant. Global and remote; the working day is set by live submissions rather than one office.

  • No on-call rotation and no weekend expectation; submission weeks have peaks managed inside the week.

  • Communication is async-first via Slack and Notion, with sync coordination around live pursuits.

Learn About TRM Speed:

  • A major tender of 500 or more questions goes from intake to a first full draft with the reviewer in five working days.

  • A mid-size RFP, RFQ, or multi-tab workbook is returned inside five business days, and a sole-source letter or pricing narrative inside 24 hours.

  • Any question answered for the first time is in the answer library within 24 hours, so the next bid that asks it costs minutes.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

About the role:

You will work directly with Account Executives and regional sales leaders to deliver practical, field-driven enablement that improves day-to-day performance across the sales cycle. Success in this role is measured by faster ramp times, improved deal execution, and strong regional revenue growth.

You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing Product Management, and the broader Enablement Team to localize and implement enablement programs that reflect the unique needs of international markets while maintaining alignment with Cresta’s global GTM strategy.

Responsibilities:

Sales Onboarding & Ramp Acceleration:

title: People Partner
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

Compensation

The Role

We're looking for a proactive, pragmatic People Partner to join us on a fixed-term basis at a pivotal part of our growth journey.

Working closely with the Senior People Partner, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the People Partnering (HRBP) model deeper into a fully-remote scale-up. You'll strengthen line manager capability, while partnering with the wider team to embed our capability frameworks as we move to a High Performance model.

You'll also pick up ER casework as and when required, providing practical support to line managers and employees. Reporting to the Director of People & Talent, you'll be a trusted point of contact across the business while getting stuck into the initiatives that shape how we work.

This is a great opportunity for a People Partner who's ready to bring strong partnering skills that drive immediate positive outcomes, balancing commercial priorities with the needs of our people. In pursuit of this you will ideally draw upon a blend of established and newer HRBP practice, applied to a purpose-led, fully-remote scale-up. A genuine interest in what we do is important too - we're looking for someone who'll always keep our members and their pets in mind.

What you'll be doing

People Partnering & Projects:

People Partners empower managers and SLT to make their teams and functions as effective as they can be, through supporting high performance, diagnosing the root cause of team issues, and amplifying capability across the business.

  • Work alongside the Senior People Partner to fully embed the HRBP (People Partnering) model across our functions in a fully-remote, scale-up environment, with People Partners embedded into specific functions as trusted strategic advisors to SLT and managers.
  • Act as a strategic sounding board for SLT and managers, always looking to understand the "why" behind a decision, pulling this back to our purpose, our members and our commercial goals, and leading with kindness throughout.
  • Get under the skin of team and functional issues, diagnosing root causes rather than symptoms, and using this insight to amplify manager and team capability.
  • Support the development and roll-out of capability frameworks (including feedback models, ways of working & role capabilities) as we move towards a High Performance model

    ER Advisory:

  • Pick up ER casework as and when required, providing timely, pragmatic support to managers and employees through investigation processes and outcomes.


What we're looking for:

  • Experience in a People Partner or HRBP role, ideally within a fully-remote, fast-paced scale-up.

  • Understanding and hands-on experience of embedding the HRBP model within a People Function, ideally within a start-up or scale-up environment.

  • A dual lens of commercial acumen and people advocacy, ensuring people decisions are grounded in business reality without losing sight of the human impact

  • Comfortable leading or supporting on disciplinary and grievance investigations.

  • Solid knowledge of UK employment law, HR policy and best practice.

  • Confident advising and building relationships with managers and employees at all levels.

  • A genuine interest in connecting people initiatives to wider business goals, with a naturally curious, solutions-focused mindset - particularly around manager capability and High Performance.

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to balance pragmatism with empathy and a strong sense of fairness.

  • Experience working in a fully-remote environment, ideally within a scale-up moving towards a High Performance culture.

  • CIPD Level 5 qualified (or equivalent hands-on experience).

  • Experience using HRIS platforms (we use Humaans) and Google Workspace is a plus.

You’ll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply.

You’ll feel like a fish out of water if:

  • You want a market with the rules already written - we're creating something that hasn't existed before, so uncertainty comes with the territory

  • You don't connect with purpose-led work - we're deeply driven by our purpose and commitment to people, pets & planet (and proud to be a B-Corp), so this needs to genuinely matter to you. Our members and their pets are at the heart of everything we do!

  • You need the process mapped out before you'll move - we're still writing the playbook, not handing you one

  • You want policy to be black and white - we’re working with humans meaning we often work in the grey, and we trust you to use judgement, not just the rulebook

  • You like everything scoped before you start - here, you'll often be figuring it out as you go

  • You're looking for a People Partnering machine to step into - you'd be one of the people building it

  • You do your best thinking alone - we're a small team, and we lean on each other and value collaboration and input

  • You need the buzz of an office to feel like you're at work - this role is genuinely remote, so you'll need to bring your own momentum

  • You like things to stay still - priorities shift fast here, and we need you to shift with them

Contract details

  • Fixed-term contract, 14–18 months

  • Reports to: Senior People Partner

  • Salary: Up to £75,000, depending on experience

  • Ideal start date: October 2026

  • Remote-first (UK-based)

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed twice a year
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

description:

This role is not intended to be reactive “shadow support.” You will be expected to deliver proactive, outcomes-driven guidance—knowing when to pull in deeper subject-matter expertise—while maintaining disciplined execution and consistent customer leadership.

Customer Outcomes and Value Realization

  • Lead structured customer motions to accelerate onboarding success, adoption, and time-to-value.

  • Bring strong product and domain credibility to guide best practices and prevent pitfalls, while engaging Support and Services appropriately—staying focused on outcomes, value realization, and forward momentum rather than becoming a reactive Q&A channel.

Reflexive GenAI Usage as a Standard

description:
Our Culture

Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

About the Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Business Consultant, you will serve as a premier strategic advisor and domain leader for Quantum Metric’s most complex, high-impact enterprise accounts. Beyond driving customer activation and operationalization, you will shape how our largest clients leverage technology by developing productized service offerings, pioneering domain-specific AI automations, and serving as a subject matter expert both for clients and internally across our entire consulting organization.

In this role, you will advise and align with senior stakeholders, navigating complex organizational landscapes from day-to-day power users to executive sponsors. You will act as the go-to subject matter expert in your specialized domain, stepping in ad hoc to advise on high-stakes client engagements, while also serving as the primary point of contact for leveraging AI to automate analytical workflows tailored to key use cases. You won't just deliver value; you will define, scale, and automate it—translating deep quantitative insights into strategic business outcomes that directly influence account retention, executive alignment, and long-term partnership growth.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Strategic Customer Outcomes: Serve as the premier strategic advisor for Quantum Metric’s most complex, high-impact enterprise accounts, aligning macro digital strategies with customer business outcomes. Navigate complex organizational landscapes to build executive alignment, establishing mission-critical status that directly drives account retention, renewal, and long-term partnership growth.
  • Pioneer AI & Scalable Value: Serve as the primary subject matter expert for leveraging AI to automate analytical workflows tailored to key enterprise use cases. Define, scale, and automate value delivery by translating deep quantitative insights into productized service offerings and repeatable frameworks that benefit the broader consulting organization.
  • Orchestrate Enterprise Domain Activation: Deploy as a targeted domain leader into strategic accounts—such as aligning with IT and Engineering teams on Site Observability—to design engagements, align senior stakeholders, and drive domain-specific activation. Embed Quantum Metric into critical operational workflows and digital decision-making processes.
  • Surface Transformational Insights: Synthesize deep quantitative data into macro-level digital and omnichannel optimization strategies, moving beyond defect detection to actively shape customer strategic roadmaps. Establish clear benchmarks for value realization and scale successful consulting methodologies across the entire practice.
  • Serve as Enterprise Subject Matter Expert: Act as a premier domain leader within assigned verticals or specialized use cases, stepping in ad hoc to advise on high-stakes, complex client engagements across the global organization. Drive the evolution of Quantum Metric’s consulting methodology by translating deep vertical or use-case expertise into reusable applications, pioneering AI-driven workflows, and establishing best practices that elevate the entire team's consulting rigor.
  • Mentor and Elevate the Practice: Act as a force multiplier across the organization by mentoring Consultants, modeling best-in-class advisory practices, and leading team enablement. Drive vertical playbooks and share specialized domain expertise in global forums to continuously upskill the broader business consulting practice.
  • Proactively Safeguard Strategic Engagements: Partner closely with primary Business Consultant to systematically identify, diagnose, and remediate high-stakes account risks across key functional domains. Step in globally on targeted engagements to design high-level recovery strategies, re-establish executive alignment, and reposition value to secure renewals and protect long-term account health.

Requirements

  • Domain Expertise: Deep specialized domain expertise in at least one key enterprise area:
  • Site Observability & Technical Performance: Experience partnering with SRE, IT, and Engineering teams to monitor digital experience performance, client-side/API errors, and application stability.
  • Contact & Call Center Optimization: Experience leveraging experience data to drive call deflection, reduce Average Handle Time (AHT), and optimize omnichannel agent workflows (e.g., Salesforce integrations).
  • Internal Applications & Employee Experience: Proven ability to apply digital analytics to internal enterprise tools to streamline operational workflows and boost employee productivity.
  • AI Proficiency & Autonomous Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to leverage AI technologies (e.g., Claude Code, AI CLI tools, LLM prompts) to streamline processes and automate analytical workflows. Strong natural resourcefulness with a track record of navigating technical ambiguity, troubleshooting complex challenges, and figuring things out independently without rigid guidance.
  • SQL & Data Engineering Proficiency: Proficient in reading, writing, interpreting, and auditing complex SQL queries and data engineering pipelines to validate backend system logic, ensure data integrity, and support deep-dive quantitative analyses.
  • Experience & Background: 8+ years of professional experience in digital analytics, digital product management, management/technology consulting, or a related field, with a proven track record of transforming complex data into executive-level business outcomes.
  • Analytical Expertise: Advanced ability to work with large, un-aggregated quantitative datasets to uncover macro-level trends, quantify business impact, and solve ambiguous, high-stakes business challenges.
  • Client-Facing Leadership & Executive Advisory: Proven experience acting as a trusted domain advisor, comfortable navigating enterprise client matrixes, interfacing with C-suite stakeholders, and deploying ad-hoc to high-stakes strategic engagements.
  • Communication Excellence: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with polished executive presentation abilities and the confidence to facilitate strategic workshops, executive briefings, and large-group enablement sessions (50+ participants).
  • Self-Starter & Collaborative Mindset: Highly proactive with a track record of driving impact independently across global accounts while seamlessly collaborating with primary Account Owners and internal practice leaders.
  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 10% to visit enterprise customers for high-impact, onsite enablement, executive sessions, and strategic workshops.

title: Senior Full Stack Product Engineer (TypeScript)
location: Canada,  Ireland,  Netherlands,  Portugal,  Spain,  UK
description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal. Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer on the Product Engineering team, you'll design and deliver high impact features, working closely with product, design, and other engineers to solve complex problems, build scalable solutions, and ensure our systems are maintainable and performant.

You’ll take ownership of projects from concept to production, contribute to architectural decisions, write high quality code, and help raise the technical bar by sharing knowledge and best practices with your teammates.

You'll work on:

  • Building elegant features for user researchers to analyze and extract compelling insights from qualitative data, using both classical techniques and large language models

  • Expanding audience management to help researchers connect with and reward participants from across the world

  • Integrating video and scheduling tools to provide a streamlined experience for managing and booking user interviews

As a product engineer at Maze, you will:

  • Partner closely with product managers, designers and other engineers to design, build, and ship new features

  • Establish best practices, frameworks, and repeatable processes that enable us to measure the impact of every feature that we ship

  • Evaluate and improve the performance, maintainability, and security of applications in production

  • Work in a collaborative and open team, which places high value on feedback, continuous learning and trust.

You should apply if:

  • You're proficient with modern full-stack JavaScript (Node.js and React) and relational databases (PostgreSQL)

  • You're enthusiastic about well-tested code and strive to improve your work environment

  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills

  • You thrive in a remote environment

Bonus points:

  • You have Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, and/or TypeScript experience

  • You have experience with AWS and/or Kubernetes

  • You're interested in UX, UI design, and the research field

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

description:
