Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Backend Engineer - Platform - Stacks

This role is available for candidates located in the UK, Germany, Spain, Ireland and Sweden.

The Opportunity:

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise.

The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts.

This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope.

What You’ll Be Doing:

The AppCore Stacks squad owns the systems that create, configure, reconcile, migrate, and operate Grafana Cloud stacks at scale. A stack is the customer-facing Grafana Cloud environment that connects an organization to Grafana and the backend services it uses, including Mimir, Loki, Tempo, plugins, dashboards, data sources, and stack-level configuration.

Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and operations. We build the control-plane services and workflows that keep stack state aligned across grafana.com, Stack State Service (SSS), Hosted Grafana, cloud regions, and the underlying Grafana Cloud infrastructure. When this domain works well, customers get reliable stack creation, safe configuration rollout, predictable migrations, and fewer manual operational interventions.

  • Design, build, and operate reconciliation systems, including the SSS backend, to track desired stack state, detect and repair drift across stack templates, grafana.com state, Hosted Grafana, and actual customer stack configuration
  • Collaborate across SSS, grafana.com, and deployment configurations to ensure stack lifecycle workflows remain reliable, observable, and resilient
  • Improve operational efficiency by reducing deployment complexity (e.g., aiming for single PR regional SSS deployment) and contributing to the Stack Config Reconciliation project
  • Manage rollout mechanisms for provisioned plugins, dashboards, data sources, Grafana versions, release channels, and stack-level configuration
  • Support new region and cluster rollouts, including the operational paths required to bring stacks online safely in new Grafana Cloud regions
  • Improve incident response and recovery paths for stack misalignment, reconciliation failures, plugin rollout issues, and Hosted Grafana integration failures
  • Partner with Product, Hosted Grafana, Infrastructure, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads on customer-impacting stack lifecycle work
  • Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations
  • You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe.

We are seeking a Backend Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and operational clarity are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain.

You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams.

Some things you might be expected to do could include:

  • Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code
  • Implementing new microservices or systems
  • Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions
  • Coordinating with product and UX when needed
  • Responding to customer requests and feedback
  • When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation
  • Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization

Requirements:

  • You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience
  • You have some experience working on a SaaS platform and are familiar with common distributed systems concepts (e.g., scalability, multi-tenancy, HA).
  • Have professional experience with Golang and be willing to work across both backend service and application code
  • Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on
  • Have some experience contributing to the delivery of projects, from initial brainstorming to shipping a product to the customer.
  • You write clean, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain
  • Can take on well-defined tasks, break them down, and execute iteratively to deliver working solutions and gather feedback.
  • You are willing to collaborate across teams and ensure your work is aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and exposure to infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.).
  • Experience participating in blameless incident response and contributing to post-incident reviews.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with TypeScript/Node.js
  • Experience with Kubernetes control-plane patterns, operators, reconcilers, or desired-state systems
  • Experience with Jsonnet/Tanka, Terraform, Flux, Argo, or similar deployment/configuration tooling
  • Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems
  • Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch

Compensation & Rewards:

In Ireland the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 81,000 - EUR 102,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

title: Leasing Pricing Specialist
description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

 

YOUR MISSION

Make sure UK Leasing always has the best-priced, best-covered deals in the market, so our sales team can draw more leads and convert more of them. This means owning the overall competitiveness of our marketplace, the deals every partner lists on it as well as Leasey's own, not just our own broker's position. You are the pricing engine behind the offer set: you find where we are missing competitive supply, own the ratebooks that power the marketplace, keep pricing accurate day to day, and guide Procurement and the Marketplace commercial team on where to find deals and at what price.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyse funder ratebooks and the Carwow marketplace to identify demand-supply whitespace, and guide the Procurement team on where to focus their supply-finding and at what price points.

  • Own and manage all ratebooks, including building custom ratebooks where a supplier does not provide one, and continually improving the efficiency of that process.

  • Manage ratebook uploads to the Carwow marketplace and third-party aggregators. Own pricing accuracy on a daily basis, removing deals and capping leads where necessary.

  • Act as the in-office pricing expert and advisor to Procurement when they uncover supply opportunities, such as dealer finance deals or commitment batches.

  • Build the models and tooling, using AI where it helps, that make pricing and the wider commercial team faster and more accurate.

  • Own the monitoring of supply and deal competitiveness across the whole Carwow marketplace, tracked by brand, model, category and partner. This covers the overall competitiveness of the deals on our marketplace, not only Leasey's own position.

  • Work with the Marketplace commercial team to make sure we are sourcing the best supply from our broker partners, using the whitespace and competitiveness analysis to steer what we ask partners for.

  • Track competitor pricing and deal scores across the market, and turn the picture into clear guidance and priorities for both Procurement and Marketplace.

 

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong analytical skills. Expert in Excel or Sheets, comfortable with BI tooling (Looker, Power BI) and ideally SQL.

  • Comfortable building models and tooling, and adept at using AI tools such as Claude and Cursor to work faster and more accurately.

  • A good grasp of vehicle leasing economics: how a monthly rental is built from residual value, cost of funds, on-the-road price, VAT and commission, and how ratebooks work. We will support the right person in deepening this.

  • High attention to detail and a bias for accuracy, with the discipline to own a daily operational process where errors are visible to Sales and customers.

  • Commercially minded and confident advising a Procurement team, able to turn analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Understanding of how marketplaces work, including the interplay of demand and supply liquidity (desirable).

  • Experience in vehicle leasing, motor finance, or another data-rich commercial or pricing environment (desirable).

  • Based at, or able to work from, our Winnersh office, partnering with Procurement in person.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Video call with a member of our Talent Team to find out more about your experience and why you want to work at Carwow

  • Step 2: 45 mins video-call with the Hiring Manager

  • Step 3: 60 mins in-person interview with the 3 members of our Carwow Leasey team

  • Step 4: Values Interview

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working - minimum 3 days per week in Winnersh

  • Competitive base salary

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • 28 days annual leave

  • 1 day for your wedding

  • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

title: Conversational Designer
description:
Cresta is on a mission to turn every customer conversation into a competitive advantage by unlocking the true potential of the contact center. Our platform combines the best of AI and human intelligence to help contact centers discover customer insights and behavioral best practices, automate conversations and inefficient processes, and empower every team member to work smarter and faster. Born from the prestigious Stanford AI lab, Cresta's co-founder and chairman is Sebastian Thrun, the genius behind Google X, Waymo, Udacity, and more. Our leadership also includes CEO, Ping Wu, the co-founder of Google Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platform, & co-founder, Tim Shi, an early member of Open AI.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of AI and ML experts, go-to-market leaders, and top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners, Sequoia, and former AT&T CEO John Donovan. Our valued customers include brands like Intuit, Cox Communications, Hilton, and Carmax and we’ve been recognized by Forbes and Bain Consulting as one of the top private AI companies in the world.

Join us on this thrilling journey to revolutionize the workforce with AI. The future of work is here, and it's at Cresta.

About the Role

As the Founding Conversational Designer for EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how Cresta delivers conversational AI solutions across the region. You’ll lead the design and deployment of best-in-class AI conversation models that power real-time coaching and assistance for contact center agents, as well as virtual agents across voice and chat experiences.

This is a highly strategic, customer-facing role that combines conversational design expertise with strong project ownership and regional influence. As one of the first hires focused on Conversation Design in EMEA, you will help establish delivery best practices, scale customer impact, and serve as a key partner in expanding Cresta’s presence across international markets.

You will manage complex AI delivery engagements from initial discovery through deployment and optimization, ensuring projects stay on track, stakeholders remain aligned, and outcomes drive measurable business value.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, Product, Project Management, and Customer Success, while acting as a trusted advisor to customers throughout implementation. You’ll also help customers design, build, and maintain their own models using Cresta Opera, our proprietary self-service platform.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end AI delivery projects across EMEA, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, build, deployment, QA, and post-launch optimization
  • Serve as a founding regional expert in conversational design, helping shape scalable delivery frameworks and best practices for international customers
  • Manage multiple concurrent customer implementations while balancing timelines, priorities, and stakeholder expectations
  • Partner cross-functionally to define scope, track milestones, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution
  • Translate customer business objectives into scalable conversational AI solutions across sales, retention, collections, and customer service use cases
  • Drive alignment with customer stakeholders through regular working sessions, solution reviews, and executive-level presentations
  • Lead model maintenance and performance tuning efforts to ensure ongoing quality and measurable impact
  • Deliver Cresta’s Opera Enablement Program to key stakeholders, empowering customers to independently design, build, and QA their own AI models
  • Design and develop virtual agent solutions using flow-based, prompt-based, and hybrid architectures
  • Contribute to internal documentation, implementation standards, and repeatable delivery methodologies as Cresta scales globally
  • Partner closely with teams in North America while helping establish regional expertise and customer success across EMEA

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including managing multiple complex workstreams simultaneously
  • Proven ability to independently own deliverables, timelines, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced environment
  • 2+ years of experience in conversational design, conversational AI, bot development, or related fields
  • Experience presenting complex solutions to enterprise customer stakeholders, including executive audiences
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers in implementation, consulting, or delivery roles
  • Experience operating in global or international customer environments preferred
  • Fluency in a second language strongly preferred
  • Background in Linguistics preferred
  • Experience with prompt engineering preferred
  • Experience with Dialogflow CX preferred

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • 20 days of vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Total compensation includes Base + Bonus + Equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. title: Senior Technical Project Manager - VPC
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Virtual Private Cloud team develops the core networking layer of Nebius AI Cloud.

We provide secure and isolated private networks, connectivity from cloud resources to internet and external networks, and networking services such as routing, security groups, load balancing and VPN connectivity.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex initiatives spanning VPC, adjacent cloud services, and infrastructure layers. These may include launching VPC in new regions, supporting new hardware generations, improving platform scalability and resilience, evolving service architecture, and delivering new customer-facing networking capabilities.
You will work closely with developers, engineering managers, technical leads and product managers of VPC and adjacent teams. You will turn broad product and technical objectives into executable programs, define outcomes and acceptance criteria, expose dependencies and trade-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and coordinate delivery through validation, rollout, and operational readiness.
 

Requirements

  1. 5+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, engineering management, or a senior technical role involving the delivery of complex cross-team initiatives.
  2. A strong technical background: you should be able to participate meaningfully in discussions about cloud networking and distributed systems, understand system boundaries and failure modes, and challenge assumptions without needing to be the primary architect.
  3. Practical knowledge of networking fundamentals such as IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, routing, network isolation, NAT, firewalls and load balancing. You should be comfortable learning and reasoning about the architecture of a production cloud-networking platform.
  4. Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly, facilitate decisions, and produce concise, actionable documentation.
  5. Proven experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple engineering teams with different priorities and dependencies.
  6. Ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify critical paths, manage risks, and adapt plans as requirements change.
  7. A practical, outcome-oriented approach and the ability to drive progress without relying on formal authority.
 

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience building or operating public-cloud or other large-scale infrastructure.
  • Experience with VPCs, SDN, network virtualization, or Linux networking.
  • Experience leading programs focused on reliability, scalability, or operational improvement.
  • Experience designing lightweight planning, risk-management, or operational-readiness processes for engineering organizations.

The Role

Analyzes and administers employee compensation programs to ensure pay practices are competitive, equitable, and aligned with organizational objectives. Conducts market pricing, builds and maintains salary structures, and classifies jobs into appropriate grades and levels. Develops pay recommendations, models financial impact of compensation programs, and administers merit and bonus planning cycles. Prepares reports and analyses for stakeholders, documents policies, monitors regulatory requirements, and drives continuous improvement in compensation workflows and data quality. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Conducts market pricing by participating in external compensation surveys, performing job matching, and evaluating competitive pay levels in base salary, bonus targets, and salary ranges.
  • Reviews and updates the company's salary structure, including pay grades and salary range spread/midpoints, to reflect market movement and internal equity.
  • Drafts, reviews, and/or edits job descriptions for consistency and completeness, evaluating and classifying new and existing job descriptions to recommend appropriate job levels, salary grades, and hourly vs. salaried statuses. 
  • Maintains job and pay records within the HRIS, auditing employee job and compensation data periodically to identify and correct errors, duplicates, and classification inconsistencies.
  • Analyzes internal compensation data against internal salary structures and recruitment data to identify pay trends and resolve pay compression or equity issues.
  • Reviews compensation requests for new hires, promotions, transfers, and internal equity adjustments, developing recommendations to support compensation-related decisions.
  • Models the financial cost of proposed merit increases, market adjustments, and promotional guidelines using budget scenarios, and presents findings to HR leadership to support the compensation programs.
  • Administers the merit and bonus planning cycle by configuring planning tools, preparing analyses and manager guidelines, auditing submitted recommendations prior to payroll processing, and reconciling planned vs. actual compensation expenditure with Finance.
  • Prepares recurring and ad hoc compensation reports, dashboards, and presentations (e.g., pay equity analyses, headcount summaries, and range penetration) for HR leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Documents and updates compensation policies, procedures, and program guidelines, monitoring federal and state compensation regulations and flags necessary policy or pay adjustments
  • Delivers training materials and educational sessions to HR representatives and managers to explain annual compensation cycles and pay administration guidelines.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve compensation processes, reporting, and data quality through standardization, automation, and improvements to workflows such as job pricing or merit cycle

Job Requirements: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Progressive experience in compensation analysis, salary administration, job analysis/evaluation, and market pricing.
  • Experience in compensation modules, spreadsheet tools using formulas (e.g., nested lookup functions and pivot tables), and market pricing data aggregation software.
  • Experience with human capital management system, compensation management system, spreadsheet software with advanced functions, and business intelligence or reporting tools.
  • Experience conducting pay equity analyses using regression-based statistical methods preferred
  • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation preferred

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group secures the land, power, and data center capacity that enables the Nebius AI Cloud. We identify where Nebius should grow next, structure the commercial agreements that make that growth possible, and partner across engineering, energy, finance, legal, and development to bring new AI infrastructure online.

We're a small, founding team building this function from the ground up, leading the acquisition of colocation, build-to-suit, powered land, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities as one of the world's fastest-growing AI cloud platforms scales.

Examples of Problems We're Solving

Determine whether a site can actually support the AI infrastructure we're planning to build. Lead multidisciplinary technical due diligence across geotechnical, environmental, civil, utility, and entitlement workstreams to determine whether a project is technically feasible before Nebius commits capital.

Build a repeatable technical due diligence program. Help establish the standards, consultant network, playbooks, and review processes that ensure every infrastructure opportunity is evaluated consistently across the Americas.

Identify technical risk before it becomes commercial risk. Work with Site Selection, Project Development, Engineering, and external consultants to identify development constraints early enough to influence negotiations, investment decisions, and project schedules.

About the Role

As a Technical Due Diligence Manager, you'll evaluate the technical feasibility of AI infrastructure opportunities across the Americas before Nebius commits capital. Working within the Infrastructure Acquisition Group, you'll lead multidisciplinary engineering due diligence across powered land and build-to-suit developments, partnering with Site Selection, Engineering, Energy, Legal, and Project Development to identify technical risk, assess development feasibility, and support investment decisions.

This is a build-phase role on a build-phase team. Many of the standards, playbooks, consultant relationships, and technical review processes you'll use are still being written—in some cases, you'll help write them. We're looking for someone who can independently lead complex technical due diligence programs while helping build the systems that make every future evaluation faster, more consistent, and more scalable.

What You'll Own

  • Lead multidisciplinary technical due diligence for powered land, build-to-suit, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities.
  • Define the scope of engineering, environmental, geotechnical, surveying, utility, and entitlement studies required to evaluate prospective sites.
  • Procure, manage, and coordinate external engineering and technical consultants from scope development through final recommendation.
  • Interpret technical findings and provide development recommendations supporting acquisition decisions.
  • Prepare technical due diligence summaries and present risks, constraints, and recommendations to executive leadership.

Technical Risk Assessment

  • Evaluate geotechnical conditions, environmental constraints, utility capacity, network connectivity and fiber access, entitlement requirements, constructability, and development schedules.
  • Identify technical risks that may impact project cost, schedule, or feasibility.
  • Recommend mitigation strategies and additional investigations where appropriate.
  • Quantify technical risks and communicate commercial impacts to Site Selection and Project Development.

Studies & Consultant Management

  • Define the scope of engineering, environmental, geotechnical, surveying, utility, and entitlement studies required to evaluate prospective sites.
  • Procure, manage, and coordinate external engineering and technical consultants from scope development through final recommendation.
  • Interpret engineering studies and translate technical findings into clear development recommendations.
  • Maintain technical documentation and due diligence records that support investment decisions.

Program Standards & Process

  • Apply Nebius' technical due diligence standards consistently across all projects.
  • Help develop and improve due diligence templates, consultant scopes, checklists, and review processes.
  • Capture lessons learned to strengthen future technical evaluations.
  • Build and maintain a trusted network of engineering and technical consultants.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Site Selection to evaluate new infrastructure opportunities and support acquisition recommendations.
  • Work with Project Development to transition technically viable projects into development.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Energy, Network, Legal, Finance, and Delivery throughout the acquisition lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with engineering firms, land-use attorneys, environmental consultants, and technical partners.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver timely technical recommendations that support investment decisions.
  • Identify development risks early enough to influence commercial negotiations and project strategy.
  • Establish consistent technical due diligence standards across the Americas.
  • Build a trusted network of engineering and technical consultants.
  • Help build the standards and processes the Infrastructure Acquisition Group runs on as it scales.

What You'll Bring

  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes where none exist. You know how to independently lead complex technical due diligence efforts while helping define how future evaluations should be performed.
  • 5–10 years of experience leading technical due diligence, site development, civil engineering, land development, infrastructure design, or large-scale industrial projects.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering and environmental consultants.
  • Strong understanding of geotechnical investigations, environmental assessments, zoning, entitlements, utility coordination, permitting, and infrastructure development.
  • Ability to interpret engineering studies and translate technical findings into business recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center, AI infrastructure, or mission-critical developments.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, or similar technical certification.
  • Experience with large-scale infrastructure acquisition or development programs.
  • Knowledge of utility infrastructure, transmission, and power markets.

Why Join Nebius

The infrastructure supporting AI is being built now. This is an opportunity to help define how Nebius evaluates the next generation of AI infrastructure while helping build the function itself—the standards, consultant network, technical processes, and playbooks that will support infrastructure investments across the Americas. You'll work on some of the industry's largest and most complex AI infrastructure opportunities while helping shape the physical foundation of the global AI economy.

title: Senior Engineering Manager | Voice
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

Voice for Meetings builds DeepL's real time AI voice technology for professional collaboration. The team works on in call transcription, translation, and voice intelligence, delivered live across the meeting platforms people already use every day.

The engineering problems are genuinely hard. Everything happens in real time, latency is measured in milliseconds, and quality is immediately visible to the person on the call. The team sits close to our applied science colleagues, so engineering and research work side by side rather than at arm's length.

This is also one of the most consequential products at DeepL right now. Voice for Meetings sits on the critical path for the next phase of the company's growth, which means the work is visible, the decisions matter, and the team has real influence over where the product goes. You will lead a small, senior team and work day to day alongside a Principal Product Manager and the team's most senior technical lead.

Your responsibilities

As Senior Engineering Manager for Voice for Meetings, you will lead the engineering team building DeepL's real time AI voice products. This is a hands on leadership role. You will be accountable for what the team builds and how well it works, and you will be close enough to the code to have a real opinion about it.

  • Lead, develop, and grow a small team of senior engineers, owning hiring, performance, and career development.

  • Drive end to end delivery of real time voice features from architecture through to production, holding a high bar for quality and pace at the same time.

  • Own the technical direction for your team's systems. Stay close enough to the detail to challenge senior engineers credibly and to get into the code yourself when it helps.

  • Work in a tight loop with your Principal Product Manager and senior technical lead, shaping what gets built rather than receiving a finished plan.

  • Operate confidently at the boundary with applied science. Understand how inference, preprocessing, and training data drift affect the product, and translate between model realities and delivery commitments.

  • Make and communicate clear technical trade offs under real constraints, including latency budgets, model quality, and timelines.

  • Spot risks and gaps beyond your own remit and fix them properly, leaving the teams around you better off rather than just unblocking yourself.

  • Build a high agency, low bureaucracy culture where engineers are trusted to make decisions and take genuine ownership of outcomes.

Qualities we look for

We care much more about how you think and what you have built than whether your background matches ours exactly.

  • You have managed engineers directly and owned a team's delivery, performance, and development. You have hired people, grown them, and handled the difficult conversations as well as the good ones.

  • You are a builder. You are comfortable in the trenches, you have real technical skills, and you have no interest in managing from a distance. If your hands on skills are a little rusty, that is fine, as long as you want to stay close to the work.

  • You have led teams building product that users touch. Real time systems, streaming, distributed systems at scale, or similar. What matters is that technical depth was the substance of the work rather than a detail in the background.

  • You have enough credibility to earn the confidence of senior engineers. You can reason about architecture, spot the failure modes, and add judgment to a technical decision rather than only facilitating it.

  • You have a pragmatic working understanding of how ML systems behave in production. Inference, preprocessing, data drift, and what breaks when a model meets real users. You do not need to be an ML specialist.

  • You think independently and act without waiting to be asked, and you draw those same instincts out of the people around you.

  • You have strong product and commercial instinct. You frame engineering trade offs in terms of user and business outcomes.

  • You are comfortable when the direction is still forming and priorities compete.

Nice to have

  • Experience with voice, speech, or audio technology, including ASR, TTS, or real time audio pipelines. A strong plus rather than a requirement, and we are genuinely open to engineering leaders from other technically demanding domains.

  • You have grown into a senior remit inside one organisation rather than moving on each time the title was available.

  • Experience building in a startup or a small product organisation, including something ambitious that did not work out.

  • Experience integrating with third party platform APIs where you do not control the other side.

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural change or technical pivot.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your pers

title: Senior Account Manager - Gaming & FS
description:
About Trustly
Trustly is a global leader in open banking payments, enabling fast, secure, and seamless account-to-account (A2A) transactions. We partner with merchants and financial institutions to deliver next-generation payment experiences, helping businesses grow while simplifying payments for consumers.


About the team
The Gaming & Financial Services (FS) Account Management team at Trustly is responsible for driving growth, retention, and strategic partnerships across two of the company’s most important verticals. The team manages a portfolio of leading gaming operators, platforms, and financial institutions, supporting them in delivering seamless, high-performance payment experiences through open banking, A2A and data solutions.

About the role
We are seeking a Senior Account Manager to join our Gaming & Financial Services Account Management team, focused on the UK market. This is a high-impact role responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of key strategic accounts.

You will act as a trusted partner to our clients, delivering best-in-class relationship management while identifying opportunities to expand revenue, increase product adoption, and deepen long-term partnerships.

This role requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a deep understanding of payments, fintech, or regulated industries such as gaming and financial services.


What you’ll do

Account Management & Relationship Leadership

  • Own and develop senior-level relationships across a portfolio of key UK-based Gaming and FS clients

  • Act as the primary point of contact, ensuring a consistently high standard of service and client satisfaction

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives

Revenue Growth & Commercial Ownership

  • Identify and execute opportunities to grow revenue within existing accounts (upselling, cross-selling, new use cases)

  • Develop and deliver account plans aligned with client objectives and Trustly’s growth strategy

  • Negotiate commercial agreements and renewals to maximize long-term value

Client Success & Strategic Support

  • Drive adoption of Trustly products and features to increase client performance and ROI

  • Monitor account performance, providing insights and recommendations based on data and market trends

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Sales, Operations, Compliance) to deliver solutions that meet client needs

Market Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the UK and EU gaming and financial services landscape, including payments and regulatory developments

  • Provide strategic input to clients on industry trends and innovation opportunities

  • Represent Trustly at industry events

Who you are

  • Strong experience (typically 3+ years) in account management, client success, or commercial roles within payments, gaming, and/or financial services

  • Proven track record of managing and growing enterprise or strategic accounts

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in revenue growth and contract negotiations

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels

Domain Knowledge

  • Good understanding of payments, open banking, or A2A ecosystems

  • Experience working with Gaming and/or Financial Services clients is highly desirable

  • Familiarity with UK market dynamics and regulatory environment is a plus

Personal Attributes

  • Hard-working, ambitious, dedicated and willing to go the extra mile to successfully close a negotiation and maximise the value of the deal

  • Very good communicator and have the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and understandable way

  • Humble with a strong business acumen

  • Take great pride in your work and strive for excellence with drive

  • Ownership mentality and accountability

  • Consider yourself great with numbers, analytical and able to use logic and problem-solving skills to find the relevant solutions

WHAT WE OFFER

At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way.

Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work.

Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location)

🌴 20 to 30 days of holiday to support a healthy work-life balance

🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues

👶 Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents

☕ On-site perks to make your workday smoother

💚 Well being support our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best

PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience!

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

Vice President of Sales, EMEA

CreatorIQ is seeking a Vice President of Sales, EMEA to lead our Enterprise Sales team and accelerate our expansion across the EU. Reporting to Brian Atwood, Chief Sales Officer, this leader will be responsible for building net-new enterprise business, expanding strategic customer relationships, and developing a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in London, offering flexibility and the opportunity to play a critical role in scaling CreatorIQ’s enterprise growth across the region.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead, develop, and strengthen a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, creating clear expectations, strong coaching practices, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Build and execute an EMEA enterprise sales strategy focused on net-new customer acquisition, and growth within existing enterprise accounts.

  • Develop a strong, sustainable pipeline and maintain forecasting discipline that improves accuracy, visibility, and predictability across the region.

  • Accelerate enterprise revenue growth by leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and helping the team effectively engage C-suite executives and senior decision-makers.

  • Proven success leading and developing enterprise sales teams and delivering sustained revenue growth.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and selling to large organizations.

  • Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence C-suite executives and senior decision-makers.

  • A strategic and commercially focused approach, with the ability to translate company growth priorities into clear regional sales plans and execution.

  • A data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, performance measurement, and sales decision-making.

  • Strong proficiency with sales tools and CRM systems, including Salesforce, and a deep understanding of pipeline management and reporting.

  • Sponsors and prioritizes responsible AI adoption, secures needed support and resources, and ensures AI initiatives deliver business value while following governance standards.

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time across EMEA.

Director, International Revenue Growth

CreatorIQ is seeking a Director or Senior Director, International Revenue Growth to build and own the marketing, pipeline, and revenue growth function across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Reporting to the VP of Revenue Marketing, this leader will be responsible for generating demand across priority international markets while serving as a strategic revenue partner to regional sales. They will work closely with enterprise sales leaders and sellers to shape go-to-market strategy for a defined set of critical accounts, create account-specific growth plans, and accelerate high-value opportunities.

The role will initially launch with support from a U.S.-based marketing team and a network of contractors. Over time, this leader will define the regional organization, hire people on the ground, and build a scalable international growth function.

This role may be based in either the UK or the Netherlands. It requires travel to London at least monthly, as well as regular travel to customer meetings, team gatherings, and field events across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, hands-on execution, strong enterprise sales partnership, and deep knowledge of the commercial and cultural nuances of European and Asia-Pacific markets. They will help CreatorIQ support its initial $8M international revenue goal while building the pipeline, operating model, and team required for the next stage of growth.

The final title, Director or Senior Director, will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, leadership background, scope, and demonstrated ability to build and scale an international revenue growth function.

This is a remote role based in the UK, with travel to London approximately 1–2 times per month. The role also requires regular travel across Europe for events and occasional travel to the Asia-Pacific region.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Build and own CreatorIQ’s international revenue growth engine across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, establishing the regional strategy, priorities, operating rhythm, resource plan, and measurement framework across key markets.

  • Generate net-new demand through integrated regional growth programs spanning account-based marketing, field marketing, executive engagement, events, partner activation, seller enablement, localized campaigns, and priority-account plays.

  • Serve as the strategic revenue partner to the RVP of International Sales, regional sales leaders, and enterprise sellers, aligning on market priorities, account coverage, pipeline goals, opportunity strategy, and actions required to accelerate growth.

  • Own the growth strategy for a defined set of critical enterprise accounts, partnering with sellers to identify buying-group priorities, shape account plans, coordinate targeted marketing support, and create account-specific engagement programs.

  • Help accelerate high-value opportunities by activating executive and customer engagement, developing relevant regional messaging and proof points, supporting buying committees, and removing marketing-related barriers throughout the sales cycle.

  • Define CreatorIQ’s strongest product-market fit and right to win by country, industry, vertical, customer segment, and account type, using customer insight, seller feedback, market data, competitive intelligence, and performance signals to focus investment.

  • Bring a nuanced understanding of European and Asia-Pacific markets into go-to-market decisions, adapting strategy, messaging, events, channels, and seller support to reflect differences in buying behavior, market maturity, business culture, procurement processes, and local conditions.

  • Establish a clear operating cadence with sales around target-account selection, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, campaign performance, forecast risk, and next-best actions for priority accounts.

  • Launch the function with support from U.S.-based marketing partners and specialized contractors, creating clear ownership, processes, standards, and accountability across a distributed team.

  • Build the long-term regional organization by defining the talent plan, hiring people in priority markets, and developing a high-performing on-the-ground international revenue growth team.

  • Deliver measurable revenue impact by supporting the initial $8M international revenue goal and building future pipeline; define KPIs, review performance, share insights, and reallocate resources toward the highest-return opportunities.

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS growth, demand generation, revenue marketing, account-based marketing, field marketing, or go-to-market leadership, with a demonstrated record of creating pipeline and revenue impact across international markets.

  • Significant experience partnering directly with enterprise sales leaders and sellers in complex B2B sales environments, with a strong understanding of long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, account planning, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and opportunity progression.

  • A demonstrated ability to both generate net-new demand and influence the acceleration of complex enterprise opportunities, with clear accountability for pipeline creation, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes.

  • Experience working on a named-account or strategic-account basis, including account selection, buying-committee strategy, executive engagement, opportunity reviews, account-specific campaigns, and coordinated pursuit plans.

  • Deep familiarity with the commercial and cultural nuances of European and Asia-Pacific markets, with the ability to adapt go-to-market strategy by country and region rather than apply a single global playbook.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional growth function, including evaluating product-market fit, prioritizing countries and customer segments, and translating market strategy into executable programs.

  • Hands-on expertise across integrated growth channels, including ABM, field and event marketing, partner programs, seller enablement, executive programs, localized campaigns, and digital demand generation.

  • Experience building a new function from the ground up, including leading through contractors and shared resources initially, then hiring, developing, and scaling a regional team.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the credibility to advise, challenge, and support sales leadership as a true revenue partner rather than simply respond to campaign requests.

  • An analytical, highly collaborative, and culturally aware leadership style, with excellent communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Comfort operating across time zones, ambiguity, distributed teams, frequent travel, and a fast-moving global environment.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
You’ll be a Technical Leader, unblock the engineering team by resolving complex technical impasses, standardising engineering practices, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

You'll still be a highly hands-on engineer, responsible for rapidly prototyping, shipping MVPs, and turning product ideas into polished user experiences. You’ll work across the stack, collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams while operating with a high degree of independence.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Build and ship new product features end-to-end

  • Lead rapid prototyping and MVP development

  • Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, Vue 3 Composition API, and Tailwind

  • Contribute to backend services using Node, Bun, Koa, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction

  • Improve performance, reliability, and developer experience across the platfor

  • Support on hiring, performance and technical roadmaps.

 

What you'll need

 

  • Extensive experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and Vue3

  • Solid backend experience with Node-based services and relational databases

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, and REST APIs

  • Comfortable moving quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and shipping iteratively

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Able to work independently in a hybrid environment

  • Ideally have been in early stage start-ups going through growth and technical challenges

 

What you'll get

  • Unlimited Holidays!

  • Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Enhanced maternity pay.

  • Pension - 8% (3% employer, 5% employee)

  • Private Healthcare (inc. dental, optical and hearing)

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice

  • Dog-friendly office.

  • Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.


About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

     

    Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

     

    Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

    Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

title: Teacher of Design and Technology
company: Westcliff High School for Boys Academy
description:
The Design and Technology Department at Westcliff High School for Boys (WHSB) has been a high performing Department for many years. The Department has grown considerably in previous years. It has consistently achieved outstanding results at GCSE and A Level and ranks amongst the best performing departments within the School. There are presently six classes taking GCSE Design and Technology in Year 10 and Year 11 and, Sixth Form numbers are regularly in the double figures.

The Department plays an important role in the extra-curricular life of the School. We offer a variety of additional clubs which students can attend, aimed at enriching their experience and extending the more able. In the Lower School we offer Technology Club, CAD Club and the Robotics Society. In the Middle School, pupils have the opportunity to be part of the Arkwright Scholarship programme and Engineering Society, whilst in the Upper School, students can take part in the Industrial Cadet Gold Award and Gold CREST Awards, which includes annual residential visits to the Department of Engineering at the University of Cambridge. The department also benefits from a thriving Food Technology department with opportunities to attend eFood Society or, Gastronomy Club.

The Technology Department occupies two workshops, a computer suite and one Food room within its own distinct building. In September 2018, the department underwent a full refurbishment to modernise facilities and create a fresh and attractive teaching environment. On a practical level, both workshops are complimented by a full range of traditional machinery including centre lathes, milling machine, brazing hearth, wood lathe and mortiser. Interest in CADCAM has increased significantly in recent years which has led to further investment in a 60W Laser Cutter and eight 3d printers.

Curriculum

The Lower School (Year 7 to Year 9) curriculum has been carefully crafted and sequenced to encourage independent learning, develop designing and making skills, alongside improving examination technique. Classes are taught on a carousel basis and transfer to a new project at the end of every term. Pupils study a range of theoretical and practical lessons based on three main areas of focus: Product Design, Engineering and Food Technology. Three lessons are taught over two weeks, within which, one is a double period. We use a range of assessment and investigations to introduce, consolidate and extend pupils’ understanding of the subject. We encourage pupils to develop a more in-depth understanding of the principles they are currently learning, and this gives them a wider breadth of knowledge.

The AQA GCSE 9-1 Curriculum follows on from the work that has been completed in the Lower School, both consolidating parts of it that have previously been covered to GCSE Level but also extending other parts so pupils can access the Level 9 GCSE grade. Sixth Form students also follow the AQA specification for Product Design.

Examination Results

The Design and Technology department has a track record of examination success: at GCSE, 60% of the 2025 cohort achieved grades 8-9, while 88% achieved grades 7-9. At A-Level, students achieved 44% A*-A and 100% achieved A*-B. Students leaving the School to study Design and Technology at university often do so at prestigious institutions.

title: Senior Financial Accountant
description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

 

About the Team

Our Finance team is the backbone of Lokalise's financial operations—ensuring accuracy, compliance, and control as we scale. Reporting to the Financial Controller and working closely with FP&A, you will step into a broad, hands-on role.

You will own month-end close and balance sheet integrity across our global entities while acting as the primary internal liaison for our external accounting, payroll, and EOR providers. Additionally, you will champion our finance automation program, transitioning the team from manual workflows to highly scalable, controlled processes.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own the month-end close across multiple entities, managing journals, accruals, reconciliations, and reporting strictly to the group timetable.
  • Own balance sheet integrity, with a specific focus on payroll and employment costs.
  • Act as the internal client for outsourced accounting, payroll, and EOR platforms. Review output, hold them to SLAs, and review/approve payroll across our US, UK, Spanish, Latvian, and EOR entities to meet statutory deadlines.
  • Prepare and post payroll/employment cost journals into the ERP, ensuring data integrity between our HRIS and payroll providers.
  • Provide detailed analysis and actionable commentary on Operating Expenses and other critical areas of the P&L.
  • Lead the charge on documenting and improving workflows. You will transition manual reviews into risk-based, threshold-driven controls.
  • Support annual audits and statutory reporting alongside our auditors and outsourced providers.

 

What You Must Have

  • 5+ years in a hands-on accounting role within a SaaS or tech company, including payroll accounting processes (journals, accruals, and control account reconciliations), month-end close, and balance sheet reconciliations across multiple entities.
  • Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or equivalent), or qualified by extensive relevant experience.
  • Experience acting as the internal client for external accounting, payroll, or EOR providers — reviewing their output and holding them accountable for accuracy and compliance. A strong accounting foundation is important, alongside experience working with one or more of these provider models.
  • Solid working knowledge of multi-country payroll and payroll-to-GL processes (journals, accruals, and control account reconciliations).
  • Accounting ERP experience and highly advanced Excel/Google Sheet skills.
  • Comfort leveraging AI and automation tools in your day-to-day work, proactively exploring how AI-driven workflows can reduce manual effort and improve controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

 

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Wider EU payroll exposure.
  • Experience with EOR providers (Oyster, Deel, Remote, Papaya).
  • Experience migrating to or implementing a cloud ERP.
  • Experience with Rillet, Ramp, Stripe or Xero.

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

 

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.
